Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 27-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Cloud Computing [IT_4441]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Analyze and explain in detail about the economic benefits of cloud computing, specifically detailing     (5)  
  the financial impact related to People, Hardware, Pay-as-you-go pricing, and Time to market.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           A large enterprise, Customer C1, contracts a mission-critical Cloud service from Provider P1.            (3)  
  Mention the types of service level agreement available to choose. Also mention the objective  
  parameters they can expect from the provider.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           List down the uses of UDDI and WSDL foundational components in the Service-Oriented                      (2)  
  Architecture.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                List out the merits of using MAX-MIN Fair allocation. Compute the max-min fair allocation for a set      (5)  
  of four sources with demands 4, 2, 10, 4 and weights 2.5, 4, 0.5, 1 when the resource has a  
  A)           capacity of 16  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           RIL Enterprises wants to use suitable compute virtualization for supporting their server operations.     (3)  
  Suggest the types of hypervisor's available for compute virtualization with its advantages and  
  explain.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Identify the scheduling objectives for batch systems in SOA?                                             (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                A company is planning to migrate its critical applications to a virtualized data centre. What strategies (5)  
  should the company implement to avoid the single point of failure. Analyse how VM Fault Tolerance  
  A)           mechanisms are used.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           How VLAN trunking can be utilized for cloud environment and mention the benefits of VLAN                 (3)  
  
  Page #1

trunking?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)         Specify the compute service name in the Openstack and list the functions of it.                             (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)              Define Cloud Service Management and state its two primary objectives in relation to an                      (5)  
  organization's business goals and consumer expectations. Also, provide any three core  
  A)         management processes and briefly state the main goal of each chosen process.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)         A financial services firm, 'GlobalTrust,' runs its high-frequency trading platform on a critical Virtual    (3)  
  Machine (VM). Any downtime during trading hours is unacceptable and results in significant  
  financial losses. Explain how the VM Fault Tolerance (VMFT) technique used for protecting  
  compute resources and ensuring continuous business operations  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)         Why are microservices better than single monolithic applications for the cloud? How do they                 (2)  
  improve scalability and make applications more reliable?  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)              Imagine a cybercriminal steals a copy of a critical Virtual Machine (VM) from a company's cloud.            (5)  
  How do you define the security threat of VM theft, and what specific locks or restrictions must the  
  A)         cloud environment implement to ensure that the VM can only run on its original, trusted physical  
  server?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)         In a cloud environment, how is a Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) used to create a secure buffer between (5)  
  the public internet and private systems?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  -----End-----
